lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in a geometric grid of horizontal rows and vertical columns posterior to the branchial area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of spots, most visible in the mid-lateral section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges characterized by a light-to-shadow gradient running horizontally across the upper lateral flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs localized within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Noticeable irregular, jagged trailing edge on the pectoral fin consistent with healed physical trauma.
